name: juce-rag
description: Deterministic retrieval grounding layer over JUCE documentation, served to coding agents via MCP. Locates and evidences; never adjudicates.

status.note: Phase state lives in ROADMAP.md only. Provisional until the human ratifies this manifest.

survey.q1_what_is_it: pipeline + service: an ingestion pipeline over the JUCE corpus feeding a deterministic retrieval index, exposed as an MCP server whose consumer is a coding agent (not a human)

q2_architecture_rung.rationale: P0-P3 are strictly sequential, each phase gates the next; available parallelism (per-source extractors) does not justify coordination overhead at this size. Revisit only if a dense-retrieval comparison sweep materialises at P5.

survey.q3_domain_core: Retrieval scoring, ranking, gate evaluation, and chunk extraction are deterministic code. No LLM in the Layer-0 grading path, ever. Any LLM use (e.g. contextual annotation at ingest) is offline, seeded, and committed as data.
survey.q4_oracle_shape: Strict pinned goldens. Layer-0: deterministic retrieval metrics (recall@k, MRR, must_contain, negative goldens) against goldens/*.yaml, CI-blocking. Layer-E: behavioural (does an agent write correct JUCE), measured, non-blocking.

q6_consumers.consumers: Claude Code agent sessions building JUCE audio plugins (sibling projects in this workspace); any MCP-capable agent
q6_consumers.is_consumer_of: the author's cross-project doctrine and harness kit

survey.q9_lifespan_autonomy: Long-lived. Interactive development (no unattended operation). Doubles as a public portfolio piece, which raises the bar on repo hygiene and README quality.
